articles.summary_en: Fernando Alonso clinched his second world championship, while Michael Schumacher concluded his Ferrari career. The Aston Martin driver cemented his legacy, marking a historic moment.

articles.title: Lando Norris risks unwanted F1 record as disastrous title defence continues
articles.title_fr: Norris en danger de record négatif
articles.title_en: Norris Faces Unwanted Record After 2025 Title
articles.summary_fr: Lando Norris, champion 2025, se trouve à la sixième place avec 201 points et six courses restantes. S'il termine sixième ou plus bas, il deviendra le premier champion en titre à finir hors du top cinq.
articles.summary_en: Lando Norris, the 2025 champion, sits sixth with 201 points and six races left. If he finishes sixth or lower, he will be the first reigning champion to finish outside the top five.

articles.summary_en: McLaren driver Lando Norris has unveiled his LN4 clothing line, inspired by 1970s racing garages, in a pop‑up at an old Austin fuel station in the United States ahead of the United States Grand Prix.

articles.summary_en: Kimi Antonelli, leading the championship, revealed he washes his car by hand. The simple habit contrasts with his title ambitions.

articles.summary_en: Fans without tickets for the U.S. Grand Prix can enjoy free F1 fan zones set up by teams and sponsors in Austin from Monday to Saturday.

articles.summary_en: The United States Grand Prix in Austin kicks off a triple‑header with Mexico City and São Paulo. Six rounds remain, and teams are fine‑tuning strategy and tires for the season finale.

articles.summary_en: Formula E chief executive Jeff Dodds said he would love to see Max Verstappen drive the new Gen4 car, the most powerful yet in the championship. He has not yet spoken to the Dutchman.

articles.title: Ferrari development driver reveals confirmed F1 test plans

articles.title_en: Fenestraz confirms 2027 F1 test with Ferrari

articles.summary_en: Sacha Fenestraz, Ferrari's simulator and development driver, confirmed he will take part in a 2027 Formula 1 test after moving from Mercedes to Maranello. He announced this during the Fuji Super Formula weekend.

articles.title: Aston Martin announces first-of-its-kind F1 partnership ahead of US GP

articles.title_en: Aston Martin partners with Padeltek ahead of US GP
articles.summary_fr: L’équipe Aston Martin devient la première en F1 à collaborer avec une marque de padel et de pickleball. Le partenariat avec Padeltek inclut des raquettes qui seront mises en vente cette semaine.
articles.summary_en: Aston Martin becomes the first F1 team to partner with a padel and pickleball brand. The deal with Padeltek includes rackets that will go on sale this week.

articles.title: FIA expects F1 races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi to run as planned

articles.summary_en: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem says the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix will run as scheduled, despite current Middle East tensions.

articles.title: FIA expects F1 races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi to continue as planned

articles.title: Why Isack Hadjar doesn’t like F1 sprints anymore
